data.one_liner: Make Windows installers for Flutter and Dart apps using Inno Setup.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to define Windows installer configurations directly in Dart and compile them using Inno Setup. It generates the installation script and invokes the Inno Setup compiler (iscc).
use_when: You need to package a Flutter or Dart desktop app into a Windows installer.
You want to configure Inno Setup scripts using Dart code instead of raw Inno Setup script files.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Windows for installation creation.
You do not want to require Inno Setup installed on the build machine.
strengths: Declarative configuration of Inno Setup scripts via Dart.
Supports advanced features like custom compression, app URLs, icons, and licensing prompts.
weaknesses: Depends on an external tool (Inno Setup / iscc compiler) being available on the host machine.
Limited strictly to Windows installer creation.
data.setup_notes: Requires Inno Setup installed on the host machine and available to the build environment.
